# SYNESIS_E010 — Error

## Description

Relation `RELATION` not declared in the template.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The relation `RELATION` used in this chain is not declared in the
  template for this field.
  Available relations: `example_a`, `example_b`.
  Use one of the listed relations or ask the project coordinator
  to add the new relation to the template.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **InvalidChainRelation**: `relation`, `valid_relations`, `relation_descriptions`
